PHARMACY CONTROL — SCP-500

Remaining inventory: TWO (2) units, down from forty-seven.

Per O5 directive, remaining units are reserved for Clearance 4 personnel exhibiting confirmed Pestilence symptoms. The pharmacy safe combination is held by the floor supervisor.
(The pharmacy safe is open. The pharmacy safe has been open since the 14th. Whoever took the forty-five did not take the last two. Perhaps they were interrupted. Perhaps they left them for someone.)

Audit note: the forty-five missing units were signed out in a single transaction by the Site Director, eleven minutes before the power interruption. The Director does not have Pestilence symptoms. The Director has an elevator key.
